description: This file contains automated UI tests for the Currency Converter feature of a calculator application, using MSTest framework. It includes setup and cleanup methods, and multiple test cases verifying input, formatting, currency switching, and UI interactions.

classes.name: CurrencyConverterFunctionalTests
classes.description: Contains setup, cleanup, and multiple test methods for verifying currency conversion UI functionality.

methods.name: ClassInitialize
methods.description: Sets up the calculator session before all tests run.

methods.name: ClassCleanup
methods.description: Tears down the calculator session after all tests run.

methods.name: TestInit
methods.description: Initializes the calculator to a known state before each test.

methods.name: TestCleanup
methods.description: Clears the UI after each test.

methods.name: NormalizeCurrencyText
methods.description: Formats a currency string to a specified number of fractional digits.

methods.name: MouseInput_EnterInputAndCheckTheResult
methods.description: Verifies entering '2' via UI and checks the result.

methods.name: MouseInput_EnterInputWithFullDecimalAndClear
methods.description: Verifies entering a decimal number and clearing it.

methods.name: MouseInput_EnterInputWithFullDecimalAndClearWithBackspace
methods.description: Verifies entering a decimal number and clearing it with backspace.

methods.name: MouseInput_SelectCurrencyWith3FractionalDigitsEnterInputAndCheckTheFormat
methods.description: Selects a currency with 3 fractional digits, inputs a number, and verifies formatting.

methods.name: MouseInput_SelectCurrencyWithoutFractionalDigitEnterInputAndCheckTheFormat
methods.description: Selects a currency with no fractional digits, inputs a number, and verifies formatting.

methods.name: MouseInput_SwitchCurrencyWithDifferentFractionalDigitsAndCheckTheFormat
methods.description: Switches between currencies with different fractional digits and verifies formatting updates.

methods.name: MouseInput_SwitchCurrencyWithLessFractionalDigitsAndEnterInput
methods.description: Switches to a currency with fewer fractional digits and inputs a number.

methods.name: MouseInput_SwitchCurrencyWithLessFractionalDigitsAndCheckIfTheResultIsConsistent
methods.description: Verifies that switching currencies with fewer fractional digits maintains result consistency.
